author: Phobiaxx
body:
Soz, my map has finally been developed far enough.... to post it, and get feedback! :D
This is a pretty unique map IMO.... and I hope it's not gonna be denied for that D:
Unique Qualities:
1.There are 2 maps in 1.(2 dimensions)
2.Dimension 1 is made in RFW style
3.There are portals! :DDDDDDD
4.Hehehehh! There's some diamonds! *MINES* wtf... I only got one iron ingot.... (troll ores!)
5.You must rush in order to defend your monument!
6.Want iron? TOO BAD. You have to fight for most of it!
7.Dimension one is made solely for bow pvp, D2 used to be solely for melee, but now a big mix.
Sorryz if this sounds negative... just trying to add some humor! xD
Spoiler:(Troll ores are only near the start! :P)
Some iron is provided at start, to distract newbies, and to help you tankers! :P
Gameplay:
The secret chests provide some quality equipment, some allowing you to destroy monuments speedily, others to killfarm :D (everyone luvs killfarmin ;p) It'll hopefully provide fun for all types of people, for you void-lovers, there's D1, for you land-lubbers(:P) there's D2, for you snipers, theres D1, and D2's towers. For you juggernauts, there's some flat, wide pvp space in D2 :)
There are some secret chests.... some 'surprises' tehehehehhh.....
Teams: Red & Blue(I'll come up with better names l8r :P)
Monuments:
Dimension 1: 1?
Dimension 2: 4.(3 of them in the open, 1 can be reached by tunneling)

Credits:
alexanderjoe(providing server)
MLGPorky(testing some things)

Just a note, comment mostly on Dimension 2... D1 is just trash atm... :P

Pictures:

D1

The Spawn!

D2(Blue side)on

D2(Red Side)
Rest of album: http://imgur.com/a/yQba7#0
Notes:D1 is far from finished, D2 is pretty much done(adding finishing touches)
More pictures will be uploaded later, especially for D1! :)

Leave your feedback below! :) (Ideas, constructive criticism, likes, boos, dat stuff :P)

Hope you like it! :D
